description: The pie chart titled “Distribution of Different Categories” shows how a dataset is divided among 7 categories, with each slice labeled by category name and percentage. The slices are Math (pink/red) at about 29.3%, Coding (blue) at about 24.3%, Information Seeking (light green) at about 22.2%, Reasoning (light orange/peach) at about 10.4%, Planning (light purple) at about 2.3%, Creative Writing (light pink) at about 2.2%, and Others (combined) (pale green) at about 9.3%. A legend labeled “Categories” appears in the upper-left and lists each category with a corresponding color and a count in parentheses (e.g., Math 410,756; Coding 339,907; Information Seeking 311,427; Reasoning 145,329; Planning 31,757; Creative Writing 30,144; Others 130,671). Percentages are shown next to the slices (outside the wedges), and no slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized; the slice sizes appear arranged with the largest segments grouped together and smaller segments clustered on the right side.
